programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Meteor is a disaster mini-series about a meteor on a collision course with Earth. After NASA discovers a giant meteor named Kassandra that threatens to erase humanity of the planet, astronomer Dr. Lehman and his assistant Imogene O'Neil must hurry to collect information about it. Lehman tragically dies along the way. Meanwhile, meteor showers are occurring worldwide causing panic. One of the towns hit by the meteorites is Taft in California. There, detective Jack Crowe is tries to find his ex partner Stark before he kills his daughter and father who is the sheriff of the town.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: When someone dies at a kennel club, McBride tries to keep the accused killer out of jail while finding out who actually committed the murder. It's quite a feat, especially when he keeps getting thrown in the slammer himself!

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Kukla, Fran and Ollie is an early American television show using puppets, originally created for children but soon watched by more adults than children. It did not have a script and was entirely ad-libbed.

programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: Rom-com with Tamara Mowry-Housley and Tia Mowry-Hardrict. Identical twins unknowingly fall for the same man - who's unaware he's dating two girls - and when they invite him to a family event, chaos erupts.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Farscape: The Peacekeeper Wars
programme.desc: American science fiction series centering on human astronaut John Crichton as the fate of the Peacekeeper race rests on his shoulders. Brought back by the Peacekeeper Alliance, Crichton is their last hope when a monstrous war is waged by the sinister Scarran Empire, and the resilient astronaut must do all he can to protect the people from being destroyed, and the universe from being consumed by the plans of the evil empire. The two-part series follows on from the original Farscape series which, after its cancellation, was left needing to be brought to a conclusion.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: The eighth season of Fear begins after the conclusion of Season 7, when Morgan's (Lennie James) and Madison's (Kim Dickens) hopes to rescue Mo from PADRE did not go as planned. programme.title: Earthsea
programme.desc: Based on the eponymous series of books by Ursula K. LeGuin, Earthsea centers on a young man whose destiny lies in his own hands; a man with the power to become the greatest sorcerer his world has ever known. The youthful protagonist, Ged, realises he possesses endless magical powers, and embarks on an adventure to master his mystical abilities. His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Killer Wave
programme.desc: The scientist and novelist John McAdams is summoned to an emergency meeting of scientists at the Preston Point Institute to discuss a tsunami that has hit the Southern New Jersey Shore. Eight years ago, John created man-made tidal waves with his Sea Lion Project; during the experiments, his beloved wife Ann had died and he quit working as scientist. Now the scientists discuss the possibility of a terrorist attack. When John returns home, he finds that someone has planted a file in his computer with classified information to incriminate him since he had written a sci-fi novel about terrorists using tidal waves to destroy the USA. When a second tsunami reaches the Maine, John becomes the prime suspect and is chased by the FBI and the police. Meanwhile he investigates the events with his former colleague and friend Sophie Marleau and when he follows the money, he discloses a huge conspiracy with economical interests of the Camtrell Corporation to construct the Sea Wall defense system to protect the American coast.

programme.title: Killer Wave
programme.desc: Suddenly the US east coast is hit by a type of natural disaster formerly reserved, except after a major earthquake, for the Pacific and Indian ocean rims: tidal waves of the destructive tsunami type. Scientist and fiction author John McAdams attends a national emergency conference which concludes the phenomenon must be man-made, quite possibly abusing the findings of John's secret former Sea Lion project, but who wants to and has the means? Indeed John soon finds himself set-up for a murder and chased. Major destructions mean major contracts for construction and coastal defenses, so building tycoons like Victor Bannister certainly have a considerable interest...

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Everything She Ever Wanted
programme.desc: Drama with Gina Gershon. A hedonistic woman weds a college dropout much younger than her to access the Atlantan high society as his father is a high-profile lawyer.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: A young Venetian, Marco is abandoned by his father for the merchant Silk Road in the hands of the Mongolian emperor, Kublai Khan, who is at war with China. Kublai recognizes Marco's observation skills, and teaches him the Mongolian culture.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: Romantic comedy with Karen Valentine. Empty-nesters Jack and Audrey Landry are in for a surprise when their three daughters return home announcing their marriages at the same time.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Comedy drama with Jeff Goldblum. During the Russian presidential elections in 1996, three American political consultants head to Russia to help a political candidate win.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: To escape evils of the Civil War, Cyrus removes his small family and random war prisoners by way of hot air balloon. Once landing on an island, the group finds they are surrounded by danger from giant insects and gold-craving pirates. Turned away by the only safe haven on the island, owned by Captain Nemo the group is forced to find shelter and survive.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Kay Woodbury is a powerful and tough judge who has not spoken to her father since he tried to involve her in a scam. At her latest case, she deals with Sally Powell, a troubled and rebellious teenager who has been in several foster homes in her life. Feeling abandoned by her biological parents, she expresses her anger to anyone who tries to grow close to her. She is given up by her latest foster parents and, because there are not any replacements available, she is put in juvenile prison.

programme.title: The Reading Room

programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live
programme.desc: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live presents an epic love story of two characters changed by a changed world. Kept apart by distance. By an unstoppable power. By the ghosts of who they were. Rick and Michonne are thrown into another world, built on a war against the dead... And ultimately, a war against the living. Can they find each other and who they were in a place and situation unlike any they've ever known before? Are they enemies? Lovers? Victims? Victors? Without each other, are they even alive -- or will they find that they, too, are the Walking Dead? The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live stars Andrew Lincoln and Danai Gurira.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Maccabi" - "Dubai"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters is an awe-inspiring ride through a world of camouflage, patience, and precision. We follow these stealthy predators as they make use of their environments and special skill sets to avoid detection until the very last second. Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action. Follow the lethal stone-fish as he waits for his prey, and the most venomous cobra in Africa as he sneaks into a weaver's nest. Prepare to be inspired by the leopard's quick-footedness and determination, and the crocodile's patient approach. A thrilling ride packed with sudden strikes from Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.desc: Enchanted Islands. We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: One of the most unique countries in the world is made up of over 7,600 islands, with more than 20 active volcanos. Besides that, the Philippines is covered in rich green forests, while its beaches are full of coral reefs. All this makes it one of the most bio-diverse places on the planet and a home to many wonderful and unusual species.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: The Equator runs two thousand five hundred miles across the great continent of Africa. The species that live here are as varied as its landscapes. Giant grazers and iconic carnivores dominate its arid grasslands while rare apes thrive in its rainforests. Here, floods follow famine year after year but the animals have adapted and evolved to make the most of their environments. This is equatorial Africa - cauldron of evolution.

programme.title: Amur Tiger: Secret Kingdom

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Animals Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory is back, and this time, the adventures are even more epic! Bertie takes us to the most spectacular corners of our planet — from Antarctica to Africa and South America to Asia – tracking down extraordinary animals to capture their daily lives like never before. Armed with drones, state-of-the-art cameras, and underwater tech, he and his team brave subzero seas, climb snow-capped mountains, and sleep suspended 120 feet in the air to reveal the challenges these animals endure, their fierce rivalries, and the threats they face on our changing planet. ANIMALS UP CLOSE WITH BERTIE GREGORY shows all the behind-the-scenes moments he and his team face while adapting to unpredictable wildlife in remote environments where filming rarely goes as planned. There is no script for this unique series, but through it all, Bertie brings the audience with him every step of the way.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive. Watch wild brumby foals find their footing in rugged bushland, while peewee chicks, bush stone-curlew chicks and monarch butterfly caterpillars face their own unique challenges on the path to adulthood. From learning what to eat and how to avoid danger to mastering essential skills through play, exploration and family guidance, every youngster must prepare for life on its own. Along the way, witness extraordinary transformations, incredible parenting strategies and surprising survival adaptations found nowhere else in the world.

programme.title: Malika the Lion Queen
programme.desc: Eyes on the Pride. Narrated by Hollywood A-Lister actress Angela Bassett, the story of Malika is one of hardship, loneliness, and determination. She must battle her uncles to establish a territory of her own where she can start a family.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Waterway Babies. Australia's rivers, wetlands, lakes and floodplains provide the perfect nursery for an extraordinary collection of young wildlife. Meet a diverse group of animal youngsters as they take their first steps, swim and dive into the world.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: From tree-climbing leopards to skull-crushing Jaguars, from fast-swimming fishing cats to quick-digging sand cats - watch the killer strategies that make wild cats possibly the deadliest family on the planet.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Secret Weapons. Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: From "The Lion King" director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Darkness. The battle between predator and prey is not always about power and strength. Knowing what lurks in the dark can mean the difference between life and death. Extraordinary powers that penetrate darkness give some creatures the edge.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers – but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Sixth Sense. To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Deception. From tigers who hunt using their fur as camouflage and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Wild, Smart, and Deadly features the planet's most extraordinary animals as they deploy a range of astonishing, secret superpowers to vanquish their enemies, hunt down prey, attract a mate and survive in the wild.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. Will the street-smart ferret succumb to his kingly charms? Smart money says… you never know! Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. Will the street-smart ferret succumb to his kingly charms? Smart money says… you never know! Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Wylde Pak

The situation gets so dire that all the drivers have no choice but to set up camp - a camp that quickly turns into its own, self-governing, rudimentary society. Struggling with a vacuum of power, Jack is chosen as their reluctant leader, but he's determined to usher them into peace. Meanwhile, Lily catches feelings for a boy in a nearby car, but because the boy's dad and Will have serious road rage beef, their romance is forbidden. // Desperate to leave their mark on Canyon Valley, Jack and Lily set out to capture the great beast of Canyon Valley Lake - a giant fish that has menaced the town for years. After being swallowed whole multiple times, Lily and Jack realize they must take a different approach, but then they hear horror stories from other townsfolk about their own run-ins with the giant fish proving that bagging the beast is an impossible task. Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Antics on Ice: Private's in heaven - icy, freezing heaven. The Lunacorns on Ice extravaganza is in town, and Skipper's determined to take him as a treat. Accompanied by unexpected fellow fanboys Bing and Roy, the gang heads to the arena. Things get a bit d-icey when the gorilla and rhino end up on the ice with the lunacorns. The enraged director is ready to shutter the whole thing unless they find some way to slip 'n slide out of it. Showdown on Fairway 18:A legendary putter is at the center of controversy when the Amarillo Kid returns to the zoo. The slippery armadillo needs Private's help to make good on an ill-advised bet with two gopher brothers. Who's the bad guy here though? The gophers show up at the zoo to actually warn the penguins about the kid! The story takes us on more twists and turns than a Pebble Beach golf hole!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: King Me/Private and the Winky Factory King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail? Private and the Winky Factory: Private's favorite treat, the Peanut Butter Winky, is going the way of the dinosaur. Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. Old enemies are now friends and old friends are now enemies as the boss bird starts to systematically clean out the zoo with the help of his new friend Hans. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.

Despite all this, Lily and Jack attempt to accomplish the impossible.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Antics on Ice: Private's in heaven - icy, freezing heaven. The Lunacorns on Ice extravaganza is in town, and Skipper's determined to take him as a treat. Showdown on Fairway 18:A legendary putter is at the center of controversy when the Amarillo Kid returns to the zoo. The gophers show up at the zoo to actually warn the penguins about the kid! The story takes us on more twists and turns than a Pebble Beach golf hole!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: King Me/Private and the Winky Factory King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail? Private and the Winky Factory: Private's favorite treat, the Peanut Butter Winky, is going the way of the dinosaur. Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Old Man & the Gun
programme.desc: Robert Redford, Casey Affleck e Sissy Spacek nella biografia di un rapinatore ‘gentiluomo’. Il film racconta la vita di Forrest Tucker, autore di un numero imprecisato di rapine in banca. Un criminale seriale che ha affascinato l’opinione pubblica e che si è reso protagonista di numerose evasioni, persino dopo aver superato i 70 anni quando scappò addirittura dal penitenziario di San Quintino. Sulle sue tracce un detective; al suo fianco una donna che lo amava nonostante tutto. La sceneggiatura, firmata dal regista David Lowery, è ispirata a un reportage apparso su The New Yorker nel 2003.

programme.title: Point Break - Punto di rottura
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze e Keanu Reeves nel cult movie di Kathryn Bigelow. Un agente FBI si infiltra in una banda di surfisti che rapina banche indossando maschere di presidenti americani.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco
programme.desc: Colpo grosso a Las Vegas per George Clooney, Brad Pitt e un cast di stelle. Un ex galeotto raduna dieci complici per rapinare un caveau nella capitale del gioco d'azzardo.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: Torna il super cast diretto da Steven Soderbergh nel sequel di "Ocean's Eleven". Per restituire i soldi del primo colpo, gli undici di Ocean sono costretti ad organizzare 3 colpi in Europa.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.title: Ocean's 8
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway e Rihanna in un'action-comedy dal regista di "Hunger Games'. Dopo cinque anni in carcere a preparare il colpo perfetto, Debbie Ocean passa all'azione e raduna una squadra di rapinatrici: vuole approfittare di una festa da ballo per rubare una collana di diamanti del valore di 150 milioni di dollari custodita all'interno del Metropolitan Museum di New York. Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinita'. La sua missione da predestinato e' fermare la guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Dora e la città perduta
programme.desc: Fiaba con Isabela Moner, live-action della serie Nickelodeon. La giovane Dora parte con il cugino e la fedele scimmia per ritrovare i genitori nella leggendaria citta' Inca di Parapata.

programme.title: Capitan Sciabola e il diamante magico
programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Speciale: Piedone 2, Uno sbirro a Napoli
programme.desc: Un accesso esclusivo al set della seconda stagione di Piedone in compagnia dei suoi protagonisti: Salvatore Esposito, Silvia D’Amico e Fabio Balsamo.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: La casa delle bambole di Gabby
programme.desc: Gabby parte con la nonna in direzione Cat Francisco. Ma quando la sua casa delle bambole finisce nelle mani di un'eccentrica gattara di nome Vera, la bambina si lancia in un'avventura nel mondo reale.

programme.title: Troppo cattivi 2
programme.desc: Pirotecnico sequel dell'amata saga di DreamWorks Animation con i personaggi nati sulle graphic novel di Aaron Blabey. I 'Troppo Cattivi' faticano a integrarsi in società a causa della loro reputazione e vengono coinvolti in una rapina ad alto rischio orchestrata da una nuova squadra di criminali: le Troppo Cattive.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Transformers 3
programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Shia LaBeouf e John Turturro nel terzo capitolo della saga prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Gli Autobot devono difendersi dai Decepticons e da un nuovo terribile nemico.

programme.title: Paddington
programme.desc: Moderna favola natalizia tratta dai libri di Michael Bond. Un orso peruviano vola a Londra alla ricerca di una vita migliore. L'amorevole famiglia Brown fara' avverare il suo sogno.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Dall’omonimo bestseller, Julia Roberts e Owen Wilson nella toccante pellicola che ha conquistato il pubblico. Un bambino affetto da una rara malformazione combatte per essere accettato.

programme.title: La strada per El Dorado
programme.desc: Viaggio nel Nuovo Mondo in una pellicola di animazione targata Dreamworks. 1519: fuggiti da un galeone spagnolo, due imbroglioni cercano il leggendario tesoro della città di El Dorado.

programme.title: Ti presento Sofia
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia di Guido Chiesa. Un uomo divorziato deve nascondere l'esistenza della figlia per conquistare una donna che detesta i bambini.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Legacy
programme.desc: Jason Reitman dirige il nuovo atteso capitolo della saga cult. Mentre la terra trema misteriosamente, due ragazzi scoprono i segreti del defunto nonno, l'acchiappafantasmi Egon Spengler.

programme.title: Free Willy: Un amico da salvare
programme.desc: L'incredibile storia d'amicizia tra un ragazzino ribelle e un'orca. Incaricato della pulizia di un acquario, Jesse fa amicizia con Willy, un'orca capace di mirabolanti esibizioni.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: 10 Lives - Un Gatto Fortunato
programme.desc: Divertente animazione targata Sky Original. Dopo aver perso la sua nona e ultima vita, al pigro micio Becket non resta che supplicare un'ultima possibilità al guardiano del Paradiso.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Ben Affleck nei panni di un personaggio con la sindrome di Asperger. Chris Wolff lavora come contabile forense ma segretamente cura le finanze di alcune organizzazioni criminali.

programme.title: Afterburn - Dopo L'apocalisse
programme.desc: Dave Bautista e Samuel L. Jackson in un action post-apocalittico. Un ex soldato lavora come cacciatore di tesori, recuperando oggetti di valore per potenti committenti.

programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Jamie Foxx in un thriller firmato Michael Mann. Un killer sequestra un tassista e lo costringe ad accompagnarlo per le vie di Los Angeles alla ricerca delle sue cinque vittime.

programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal nel remake del cult 'Il duro del Road House'. Un ex lottatore accetta un lavoro come buttafuori in un bar, ma si ritrova a fare i conti con un boss criminale.

programme.desc: Paul Haggis dirige un thriller con Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks e Liam Neeson. Un uomo si trasforma in criminale per far evadere la moglie, accusata ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Il Ministero Della Guerra Sporca
programme.desc: Action di Guy Ritchie ispirato a una storia vera con Henry Cavill. Seconda guerra mondiale: un'unità segreta viene reclutata per neutralizzare la flotta di sottomarini tedeschi.

programme.desc: Avvincente action movie basato su un romanzo di Robert Littell, con Rami Malek che veste i panni di un crittografo della CIA. L'uomo decide di vendicarsi personalmente dei terroristi che hanno ucciso sua moglie.

programme.desc: Spettacolare fanta-action con Tom Cruise ed Emily Blunt. Intrappolato in un loop temporale, un soldato rivive piu' volte il combattimento contro una stirpe di alieni.

programme.desc: Action con Liam Neeson al confine tra Messico e Stati Uniti. Un allevatore, veterano del Vietnam, difende un bambino immigrato dagli implacabili assassini di un cartello del narcotraffico.

programme.desc: Courteney Cox e il ritorno di Neve Campbell nel settimo capitolo dell'iconica saga slasher. Un nuovo Ghostface terrorizza Pine Grove: nel mirino c'è la figlia di Sidney.

programme.desc: Ray, ex soldato britannico, si è da tempo autoesiliato dalla famiglia e dalla società. Quando Jem, il fratello, parte alla sua ricerca, segreti nascosti e rancori sepolti da tempo vengono alla luce.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: La Vita È Bella
programme.desc: Guido e la famiglia vivono il peso delle Leggi Razziali. Ebreo, viene deportato in campo di concentramento con il figlioletto Giosuè. L'uomo costruisce quindi un elaborato mondo di fantasie per proteggere il piccolo dagli orrori della guerra.

programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.desc: Andrea Carpenzano nel film Sky Original di Francesco Lettieri. L'ascesa e il declino di Nic, in arte Lovely Boy, astro nascente della scena musicale romana finito nel baratro della droga.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.desc: Biopic con Daniel Day-Lewis ed Emma Thompson diretti da Jim Sheridan, Orso d'oro a Berlino. La drammatica vicenda giudiziaria di 4 irlandesi condannati ingiustamente per terrorismo.

programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Michele Placido, Silvio Orlando, Claudio Santamaria e Paola Cortellesi in un film che segue le vicende di 3 operai in lotta contro la chiusura della fabbrica.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Una vita in fuga
programme.desc: Sean Penn dirige e interpreta con la figlia Dylan il biopic su John Vogel. La doppia vita del piu' famoso e inafferrabile truffatore d'America, raccontata dal punto di vista della figlia.

programme.title: Green Border
programme.desc: Premio speciale della giuria a Venezia 2023 al film di Agnieszka Holland sulla crisi dei rifugiati. L'odissea di una famiglia siriana al confine tra Bielorussia e Polonia.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.title: Cosa sarà
programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.title: Il Dono Piu' Prezioso
programme.desc: Mandato al campo di Auschwitz, un padre getta dal treno uno dei suoi figli gemelli. Un povero taglialegna raccoglie un pacco caduto nella neve e il piccolo fagotto si rivela essere ciò che aveva atteso con tanta impazienza.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s) - Un omicidio di troppo
programme.desc: Commedia a tinte gialle targata Sky Original con Jon Hamm e Tina Fey. In una polverosa citta' dell'Arizona, il capo della polizia si trova alle prese con gli omicidi di due donne omonime.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Omicidio a Los Angeles
programme.desc: Eccentrica commedia Sky Original con Mel Gibson e Charlie Hunnam. Un ex poliziotto lascia la sua casa nel bosco per indagare su un delitto di cui è stato accusato un divo della tv.

programme.title: Game Night - Indovina chi muore stasera?
programme.desc: Jason Bateman e Rachel McAdams in una mystery-comedy. Un gruppo di amici impegnati in un gioco di societa' scoprono che il crimine su cui stanno indagando per finta e' davvero accaduto.

programme.title: Il mostro
programme.desc: Residente in un condominio alla periferia di Roma, l'innocuo e gentile Loris è scambiato per un maniaco che ha già seviziato e ucciso 19 donne. Per smascherarlo, la polizia gli mette in casa un'avvenente poliziotta.

programme.title: Scordato
programme.desc: Deliziosa commedia di Rocco Papaleo, anche protagonista accanto a Giorgia. Un accordatore di pianoforti si scopre affetto da una contrattura 'emotiva'.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Un uomo imponente, ma dal cuore d'oro, commercia banane che scambia con prodotti destinati agli indigeni di un piccolo villaggio colombiano. Un giorno, un boss della mala decide di gestire il commercio della frutta e di costruire un casinò illegale.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Poveri Noi
programme.desc: La ricca famiglia Mariani affronta la rovina finanziaria ed è costretta a trasferirsi in una zona popolare, dove le persone che hanno sempre disprezzato in passato si rivelano le uniche disposte ad aiutarli.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni 3
programme.desc: Torna Bradley Cooper con i suoi pazzi compagni di avventura in un'altra folle notte. Il quartetto di amici finisce in un vortice di incredibili imprevisti dopo un inaspettato sequestro.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Immaturi - Il viaggio
programme.desc: Commedia con Raoul Bova, Ambra Angiolini e Barbora Bobulova. Per celebrare la raggiunta maturita', gli amici scelgono una vacanza su un'isola greca, circondati da mille tentazioni.

programme.title: La prima pietra
programme.desc: Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino e Kasia Smutniak in una graffiante commedia sull'Italia di oggi, scritta e diretta da Rolando Ravello. Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Scordato
programme.desc: Deliziosa commedia di Rocco Papaleo, anche protagonista accanto a Giorgia. Un accordatore di pianoforti si scopre affetto da una contrattura 'emotiva'.

programme.desc: Dopo aver sgominato una rapina, l'indagine su un caso di possibile suicidio porta Frank Drebin jr. sulle tracce di Richard Cane, magnate della tecnologia che ha escogitato un piano criminoso per riportare l'umanità a uno stadio primordiale e ferino.

programme.desc: Una scuola privata, gestita da sacerdoti, organizza per alunni ed ex alunni una gita di quindici giorni negli Stati Uniti. Il gruppo scatenato è accompagnato da un giovane prete ciociaro e da un prete più anziano, vittima ignara di scherzi.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Lillo & Greg, star di una commedia degli equivoci con Anna Foglietta e Francesco Mura. Due ex compagni di scuola decidono di scambiarsi i rispettivi codici genetici.

programme.title: Papà scatenato
programme.desc: Due famiglie molto diverse a confronto per un mix di gag e risate in una commedia con Robert De Niro e il comico Sebastian Maniscalco.

programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.desc: Il telefilm culto degli anni 70 diventa una commedia poliziesca con Ben Stiller e Owen Wilson. Indagando su un omicidio, i due detective seguono la pista che conduce a un narcotrafficante.

programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.desc: Billy Wilder dirige Jack Lemmon e Walter Matthau in una storica commedia sul giornalismo. Chicago, 1929: un condannato a morte si rifugia nella sala stampa del Palazzo di Giustizia.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Da grande
programme.desc: Renato Pozzetto in una delle sue commedia di maggior successo. Un bambino di otto anni esprime il desiderio di diventare adulto. Il miracolo si avvera e lui diventa un uomo di 40 anni.

Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. Cast arricchito da Christian De Sica, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato e da un cameo di Moana Pozzi.

programme.title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
